schema: Canby Court facade / exterior appearance record, one per house. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Blender build (blender/build_scene.py reads it). Every field = {value, confidence, source}.

confidence_levels.measured: computed from imagery pixels or GIS geometry
confidence_levels.observed (aerial): seen on the 2022/2024 nadir orthophotos (roof-level features only)
confidence_levels.inferred: era/style norm or artistic choice - REPLACE when photos are available

how_to_update: Edit values here (e.g. body_colour.value = '#hex' from a photo, confidence = 'observed (photo)'), then re-run: /home/user/venv/bin/python blender/build_scene.py && blender/export_web.py. Colours are sRGB hex. 'trim' as a colour means use trim_colour. wall_point = a point on/near the footprint wall where the door is centred (local metres).
palette_note: muted Pacific-Northwest suburban palette; colours deliberately varied between neighbours
